```yaml
---
id: vuln-dectalk-tts-3600d8ac
pattern-sources:
  - path: src/index.ts
languages:
  - typescript
message: 'HTTP request to dectalk API is insecure. Use HTTPS instead of HTTP.'
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-31206
  cwe: CWE-300, CWE-319, CWE-598
pattern-not-found:
  message: 'HTTP request to dectalk API is secure. HTTPS is used.'
```
This Semgrep rule will detect HTTP requests to the dectalk API and raise an error. It does not match the patched behavior, as the URL scheme is changed from 'http' to 'https'.
